# slice1: the eight slice-1 libraries (M1-M3)

Started 2026-11-21 on top of main `9fb50b0` (M0 + CI). Design: `.github/devdocs/DESIGN.md`. Rules: `.github/devdocs/CONVENTIONS.md`. Previous record: `.github/devdocs/m0/PLAN.md` (D1-D45, M0-F1-F23). Decisions here continue at D46; findings are S1-F1 onward.

Tags: **V** verified, **I** inferred, **A** assumption.

Scratch paths used below: `R=/data/gamma/luciorq/workspaces/temp/r-zig-pixi/libs-recipes` (per-recipe builds `$R/out-<pkg>`, logs `$R/build-<pkg>-<subdir>.log`, integration logs `$R/slice1-logs/`, caches `$R/slice1-cache-*`), `B=/data/gamma/luciorq/workspaces/temp/r-zig-pixi/libs-slice1` (the integrated channel). `pixi.lock` is unchanged by this slice: sha256 `8849a4ea327f483c4d9a20fb053f3653ccbd2d857194dbce1df976daa9132b1e`, `pixi lock --check` up to date (V).

## Goal

Milestones M1-M3 of DESIGN 9: the eight libraries of slice 1 (DESIGN 6.1) as zig-* packages for win-64 and win-arm64, next to M0's zig-toolchain and zig-zlib:

- M1: zig-sqlite 3.51.2, zig-expat 2.7.3, zig-openssl 3.6.0
- M2: zig-geos 3.14.1, zig-proj 9.7.1, zig-abseil 20250127.0, zig-onetbb 2022.2.0
- M3: zig-gdal 3.12.1

Each is cross-built on linux with the library's own build system (D1), ships only static `lib<n>.a`, closed and relocatable `.pc` files under `Library/zig-libs/<triple>/` (DESIGN 5.4, 5.5), and passes its recipe test on linux and on Windows. Together they are what sf, terra, gdalraster and s2 need (D13); linking those R packages is M4.

## Scope

In:
- Eight recipes `recipes/zig-{sqlite,expat,openssl,abseil,onetbb,geos,proj,gdal}/` and their smoke sources in `tests/smoke/` (`sqlite.c`, `expat.c`, `openssl.c`, `abseil.cpp`, `onetbb.cpp`, `geos.c`, `geos.cpp`, `proj.c`, `gdal.c`).
- Toolchain: `toolchain/src/closepc.zig` fixes found while packaging (D62, D63, D64, D75). `zig_toolchain` stays 0.1.0 (D70).
- Tests: `tests/pkgtest.zig` gains C++ links and closure-wide symbol checks (D65), replacing five per-recipe test programs; `tests/smoke/link.sh` links against all packages of a subdir (D66, D76).
- Wiring: `pixi.toml` `build-libs` lists all nine in dependency order; `variants.yaml` is the only place for versions (D69); `.github/workflows/build.yml` timeouts and a test step that tests every package (D72, D73).

Out:
- R package links (`R CMD SHLIB`, rzig) and the DLL smokes DESIGN 5.10 asks for from M2 on: M4, in r-zig-pixi.
- linux/macOS (D5), GDAL network drivers and slice-2 libraries (D6).
- Publishing (M5).

## Decisions

All dated 2026-11-21 and "default (user may revisit)". Three need the user's eye because they go against the task text or change upstream source: **D50** (OPENSSLDIR), **D51** (removed `lib/cmake/OpenSSL`) and **D53** (abseil source patch).

Toolchain: zig 0.17.1 (conda-forge), zig-toolchain 0.1.0 `zig_69dc1b3_0`; cmake 4.5.1, ninja 1.13.2, clang 22.1.8 (geos log). Build strings of the integrated channel `$B`: win-64 sqlite `zig_1d5992e`, expat `zig_7fcb7fd`, openssl `zig_436c1ea`, abseil `zig_2e57825`, onetbb `zig_d03d386`, geos `zig_573ba6a`, proj `zig_4f71b06`, gdal `zig_d646007`, zlib `zig_29ef852`; win-arm64 `zig_a7da9fc`, `zig_2b3eccd`, `zig_daa5ad0`, `zig_90e5f06`, `zig_2163197`, `zig_e4446d8`, `zig_776cbfe`, `zig_e59a93e`, `zig_6e0c9c0`; all build number 0 (V, `ls $B/<subdir>`). Run dependencies match each `.pc` `Requires:`: gdal → proj, geos, sqlite, expat, zlib; proj → sqlite; openssl → zlib (V, `index.json`).

**S1-F2 V. Everything builds from scratch with the repo's tasks, as CI calls them.** `CI=true LIBS_ZIG_OUT=$B` with fresh rattler and zig caches: `pixi run --locked -e default build-toolchain` rc=0 (221 s), `build-libs win-64` rc=0 (1150 s), `build-libs win-arm64` rc=0 (938 s); every recipe test `✔ all tests passed!`. `pixi run test <pkg>` again for all 19 packages: each `$R/slice1-logs/retest-*.log` ends with `all tests passed`, and each of the 18 win-* logs has one `pkgtest: all checks passed`. `pixi run check-alignment` over `$B`: `build alignment OK: 10 package version(s) over 3 subdir(s)`, rc=0. Correction: the rc values in `$R/slice1-logs/retest-summary.txt` are not evidence; its script expanded `$?` after command substitutions in the same word (`bash -c 'false; echo "$(basename /a/b) rc=$?"'` prints `b rc=0`), so it always wrote rc=0. The re-run script `$R/fix2-logs/retest.sh` takes `rc=$?` on its own line.

**S1-F3 V. close-pc had three bugs, now fixed.** Reproduced with one crafted `.pc` (review): `pkgconf --cflags t` drops `Cflags.private` (only `--static` prints it), so expat's `-DXML_STATIC` was lost; a `# http://…` comment made close-pc fail (`line 9 keeps an absolute path`); the prefix was replaced as a plain substring. Fixed by D62, D63, D64, then D75. `zig build test` in `toolchain/`: `Build Summary: 3/3 steps succeeded; 22/22 tests passed` before D75 (the `failed command:` line in its output comes with expected-failure stderr from the tests; exit 0). Installed results: `expat.pc` `Cflags: -I${includedir} -DXML_STATIC`, `Libs: … -lexpat -lm`; `tbb.pc` keeps its licence header; `geos.pc` `Libs: -L${libdir} -lgeos_c -lgeos -lc++ -lm`. A prefix with a trailing slash (`prefix=/p/`) is refused (`line 4 keeps an absolute path`, rc=1), which fails safe.

**S1-F12 OpenSSL asm and the `-mcpu=` lines.** V: asm is on for both arches, mingw64 perlasm on x86_64 (`perl crypto/aes/asm/aesni-x86_64.pl "mingw64"`), win64 perlasm on arm64 (`aes-sha1-armv8.pl "win64"`); `no-asm` appears in neither log. V: the win-64 build prints 42 `zig: error: unsupported option '-mcpu=' for target 'x86_64-windows-gnu'` lines (`$R/slice1-logs/build-libs-win-64.log`), the same count as the earlier per-recipe build (`$R/build-openssl-win-64.log`), 0 on win-arm64; the build and its tests pass. I: they come from an assembler probe, not a compile: the log has 41 perlasm calls and the lines sit among them; the perlasm scripts probe `$CC -Wa,-v -c -o /dev/null -x assembler /dev/null` and `$CC -v` (`crypto/aes/asm/aesni-sha256-x86_64.pl` lines 59, 74). Not confirmed: run by hand through `x86_64-w64-mingw32-cc`, the first probe fails with a different message (`unsupported argument '-v' to option '-Wa,'`) and the second prints `clang version 22.1.8`. 24 upstream-typical warnings (`SOCKET`→`int`, `volatile` in `threads_win.c`) not investigated.

**S1-F13 V. zig's MinGW headers announce Windows 11 but lack `windows.globalization.h`.** zig's `sdkddkver.h` sets `NTDDI_VERSION` to `NTDDI_WIN11_GE` (newer than `NTDDI_WIN10_NI`), so abseil's cctz takes the WinRT time-zone path and fails to compile. Patched by D53; abseil's local time zone on Windows then follows `TZ` or UTC, unlike CRAN's build (I). Other libraries that test `NTDDI_VERSION` may hit the same gap.

**S1-F14 V. OpenSSL keeps one driveless path.** `CTLOG_FILE` still contains `/zig-libs/<triple>/ssl/ct_log_list.cnf`. It is read only when an application calls `CTLOG_STORE_load_default_file`; s2 does not (I). Removing it needs a source patch. Behaviour with the `OSSL_WINCTX` registry key present is not tested.

**S1-F22 V. PR #2 CI run 44967259971 (head 3933eb7), 2026-11-22: all four cross jobs failed at zig-gdal's configure check.** toolchain (both zigs) passed; cross win-64 and win-arm64, default and upstream-zig, built the seven libraries before GDAL, then `zig-gdal: SWIG_DIR:PATH=/usr/share/swig/4.4.0 is not in $PREFIX/Library/zig-libs/<triple>`, exit 1. The test and alignment jobs failed only because there were no packages (no package was tested). Cause: GDAL's top-level `CMakeLists.txt:186` calls `find_package(SWIG)` (optional) even with every `BUILD_*_BINDINGS=OFF`; the toolchain file searches programs on the build host (`CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_PROGRAM NEVER`), the ubuntu-24.04 runner has `/usr/bin/swig`, and the recipe's check that every found library, include and package dir is in `$ZIG_LIBS_PREFIX` rejected the cached `SWIG_DIR`. gamma has no swig, so the local builds never saw it. Fix: `-DCMAKE_DISABLE_FIND_PACKAGE_{SWIG,Python,JNI,Java,CSharp}=ON` in `recipes/zig-gdal/build.sh`; GDAL uses them only for bindings and autotests (`CMakeLists.txt:186-250`, `cmake/helpers/CheckDependentLibraries.cmake:510-518`); decision D78. Verified locally: the fixed recipe builds zig-gdal win-64 with a fake `swig` first on PATH, configure shows the five flags, build string unchanged `zig_d646007_0`, `all tests passed`. Not reproduced locally: with the fake swig in a scratch dir on PATH (PATH does reach the build script, checked with a probe recipe), the old recipe's GDAL configure printed `Could NOT find SWIG` and never ran it, while a bare CMake project with the same toolchain file and cmake 4.5.1 found it; the cause of that difference is not known. The next PR run is the check. The `-mcpu=` errors in the CI log are OpenSSL's configure probes, 42 also in the passing local log (S1-F12).

## Not verified

- The toolchain test count after D75: the 22/22 above predates it; S1-F21's `toolchain-test` passed (rc=0) but its count is not recorded.
- R packages (M4): `R CMD SHLIB`/rzig links of sf, terra, gdalraster, s2; the DLL smokes DESIGN 5.10 asks for from M2 (D20); multi-threaded terra and `dyn.unload` with TBB workers (S1-F6); s2 itself against the 26 abseil modules (the module list comes from the task text, not CRAN's s2 `configure.win`).
- GDAL driver parity with the Rtools build (166 drivers here; CRAN's set not counted), and Shapefile in the smoke (S1-F20).
- OpenSSL with the `OSSL_WINCTX` registry key present (D50, S1-F14); TLS handshakes and providers beyond SHA-256.
- The sqlite option set against a real Rtools build at run time (only DESIGN 6.2's list).
- A real CMake consumer of the remaining configs (absl, TBB, GEOS, expat).
- That `proj.db` equals the Rtools build's.
- The cause of OpenSSL's 42 `-mcpu=` lines (S1-F12).
- Why the local fake swig was not searched (S1-F22); the fix itself passed on the hosted runner (S1-F23).
